api.description: Adjust available stock by a signed delta at one location, with a reason

fields.description: Signed change: positive adds stock, negative removes it.
Expected quantity before the change. Set it to turn the write into a compare-and-swap, which fails when the current quantity differs. Omit it to skip that check.

Key that makes this adjustment safe to repeat. A new key is generated for each call when omitted, so two identical adjustments both apply; pass the same key again only when retrying the same adjustment.
